purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver compilation of a Delvehold branch-and-fold fixture about a public pump failure whose parts, fuel, insurance, route deductions, labor, and household losses arrive under different owners.

local_awareness_summary.text: Orsa is a dwarven pump-house apprentice who knows Cistern House Nine's machinery, service routine, delivery seals, local repair tools, and the visible consequences of falling terrace gauges.
Orsa may read the workshop's public invoices and perform assigned work, but Master Hessa alone owns the civic seal that can bind the workshop to a repair, debt amendment, or service state.
The district has about ten hours of upper-terrace stored water, up to two days below, a late water-note payment, a short crystal delivery, and a certified spare part held under consortium claim.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains Orsa's apprentice-local viewpoint. Choices use reachable bins, scales, files, collars, pumps, slates, notices, and carrying work rather than authority she does not possess.
The opening establishes routine invoice and maintenance work before Engine Two fails; three choice layers branch locally and fold through shared material state.
Tonal mode is wry civic workplace comedy under debt pressure: jokes expose accounting, class, and contract absurdity while dry taps and winter claims retain weight.

authority_boundaries.text: Orsa can propose, prepare, record, install under supervision, carry evidence, and join rationing; she cannot apply Hessa's civic seal or bind the district herself.

Dema owns the public copy of visible figures but not technical diagnosis; Brin owns journeyworker craft judgments but not the civic seal; Hessa owns only the workshop decision, not every route, insurer, creditor, or household consequence.

object_custody.text: Crystal bins and route tickets, the recut collar and old gauge, Basalt Crown's cord-sealed certified collar, Seven Seals' refusal notice, Dema's public slate, Hessa's civic seal, and the last crystal reserve retain distinct custody throughout the folds.

required_semantics.text: Every branch must move a material cost among water service, future crystal priority, warranty, route accountability, local skill, worker time, or household loss.
The story must show that a failed cistern costs more than the workshop ledger records and that truthful anomaly reporting can trigger an insurance exclusion without proving the anomaly's cause.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not let Orsa sign debt, apply a civic seal, commandeer route offices, or settle insurance policy for the district.
Do not diagnose the prior blue reroute as machine-dungeon agency or treat consortium, insurer, route office, Reserve House, workshop, and district as one authority.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three four-option choice layers fold through the collar failure and shared cost ledger, then resolve into eight state-gated endings.

branches.actor_intent: Separate route deductions and unexplained loss from local pump consumption.
state_basis: Orsa can handle the delivery bins and read their seals; Dema can preserve public weights and ticket custody.
reviewed_consequences: Raises route_proof, public_record, and worker_burden; later enables a source-backed route and insurance hearing.

branches.actor_intent: Prepare a locally maintainable replacement before a breakdown makes the certified crate the only apparent option.
state_basis: Brin owns the old workshop gauge and may train Orsa to recut a discarded collar.
reviewed_consequences: Raises local_part and worker_burden while lowering warranty_status; unlocks the local repair response.

branches.actor_intent: Make arrears, part custody, and exclusions visible before failure changes the bargaining field.
state_basis: The workshop figures are public obligations and Dema maintains the landing slate.
reviewed_consequences: Raises public_record and note_pressure; improves later accountability while exposing Hessa's late payment.

branches.actor_intent: Spend scarce crystal to buy upper-terrace households time before the invoice is settled.
state_basis: Orsa can run Engine One for an assigned measured fill; the public header tank is visible on the gauge.
reviewed_consequences: Raises district_buffer and water_flow while lowering crystal_stock; materially improves the rationing ending.

branches.actor_intent: Restore water through supervised local craft while openly surrendering warranty protection.
state_basis: Available only when the recut collar was prepared; Hessa witnesses rather than retroactively certifies it.
reviewed_consequences: Raises water_flow, worker_burden, and public_record while setting warranty_status to zero.

branches.actor_intent: Restore immediate service by making Hessa explicitly pledge winter crystal priority.
state_basis: Only Hessa seals the amendment; Orsa cuts the consortium cord after the public reading and stamp.
reviewed_consequences: Raises water_flow, note_pressure, warranty_status, and public_record while spending crystal_stock; creates a visible future winter claim.

branches.actor_intent: Preserve immediate water with higher crystal burn and worker attention instead of taking new debt.
state_basis: Engines One and Three remain operable but running above ordinary draw consumes reserve and requires a watch.
reviewed_consequences: Raises water_flow, worker_burden, and district_cost while lowering crystal_stock and warranty_status.

branches.actor_intent: Keep the pumps safely isolated and expose the insurer-creditor bind at immediate district cost.
state_basis: Orsa can seat assigned wedges and transfer the notice to Dema; she cannot settle the policy.
reviewed_consequences: Raises public_record and district_cost while lowering water_flow, district_buffer, and note_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Put the route chain, refusal clause, and district cost before seals belonging to each affected owner.
state_basis: Success requires both route_proof and a sufficiently complete public_record.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a shared-owner hearing or a cost ending where correct stamps defeat an incomplete accusation.

branches.actor_intent: Convert an improvised recut part into inspectable shared skill under Hessa's seal.
state_basis: The option is available only when the local collar was prepared; success further requires surrendered warranty, restored flow, and a worker burden low enough to sustain inspection.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to local capacity or a cost ending where independence lacks a working part or labor owner.

branches.actor_intent: Keep the certified repair running while making its winter claim visible to the district.
state_basis: The option is available only after an accelerated note was sealed; success further requires restored flow and at least two crystal measures left.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to immediate water with visible future scarcity or a cost ending where debt cannot replace missing stock.

branches.actor_intent: Protect the last crystal and make remaining water time legible by street and use.
state_basis: Success requires stored district buffer or ongoing partial flow.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to rationed deliberation or a dry ending that itemizes wage, food, care, and cartage losses.

automated: Ink variable changes for local playthrough state
manual_review_required: Durable Delvehold canon promotion beyond the authored Nine-water note subsection
Any claim that a specific branch outcome happened canonically

audit.reviewer: Codex titled elaborator using the four required reviewer prompts
review_notes: Narrative quality verdict: accepted. Reader orientation 5/5, coherence 5/5, pacing 4/5, voice 5/5, tonal fit 5/5, and IF playability 5/5. The pass gated final local-repair and accelerated-debt choices behind the objects and prior commitments they require, removing folded paths that referred to absent parts.

Lore grounding verdict: accepted. Source coverage 5/5, canon fit 5/5, grounding quality 5/5, and vault backfill value 5/5. The pass removed Hessa's personal name from the canonical water-note debtor so the lore owns the workshop seal and the fixture retains character-event authority; it also clarified crystal transit from rail and lift into the conduit-fed pumps.

Visual continuity verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions as an illustrated-IF scaffold, not replay-ready art. Segmentation 5/5, prompt quality 5/5, character visibility 5/5, branch continuity 5/5, and website replay 4/5. Eleven unique base scenes and twelve branch modifiers cover every focal shift and branch consequence; memory-dependent wording, off-frame character mention, negative direction, and unstable base-state alternatives were removed. A durable plan view or 3D blockout remains required before high-consistency multi-angle rendering.

Spatial-geometric cohesion verdict: accepted_with_minor_revisions as a stageable text plan. Layout 5/5, sightlines 5/5, body affordance 5/5, movement and access 5/5, object-system geometry 5/5, and branch spatial state 5/5. The pass replaced unsupported bin lifting with a low roller scale and straight approach, gated absent-part actions, and kept seal, public-record, worker, route, ration, and repair authority at distinct reachable stations. A plan view or simple 3D blockout remains the only replay-readiness gap.

Per pass constraints, Ink compilation was not attempted and no compiler was installed. JSON parsing, schema-version checks, header inspection, knot-target validation, variable-use counts, branch-to-sidecar coverage, visual-anchor resolution, visual-ref resolution, modifier-target checks, and prompt-language scans were performed.
